reply_text:
I replied to Pree in a thread on their message in #central-team. I said the new inbound lane at Marrow Agrisupply is at Dock 23 and that the note stays in that channel for anyone who needs it.

They said no action was needed, so I didn't do anything else. I also didn't save the dock to my persistent memory. The note sits in #central-team, where only that channel's members can see it, and keeping a copy in memory could lead me to repeat it later to someone who isn't in the channel.
